ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent that monitors Delhi air quality trends on X, predicts hazardous spikes, and automatically triggers localized micro-grants via crypto escrow for community mask distribution.
ideas.title: DelhiAirGuard Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the autonomous AI agent and trend-fetching patterns seen in winning projects like Dispatch and xbot-ai, while addressing a hyper-local Delhi problem that instantly resonates with local hackCBS judges.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge gated platform where verified Delhi university students can vote anonymously on campus policy changes using ZK-proofs without exposing their student IDs.
ideas.title: ZeroKriti
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies advanced cryptographic gating and privacy patterns proven in winning projects like openstoa and x402-zkid, demonstrating hard engineering within a tight timeframe.

ideas.pitch: An EigenLayer AVS where decentralized node operators use Claude AI to validate and optimize live traffic congestion mitigation strategies across major Delhi intersections on-chain.
ideas.title: DelhiTraffic AVS
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact winning architecture of Etherfi by combining complex AVS validation with LLM decision-making, appealing strongly to judges looking for deep infrastructure plays.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-chain yield aggregator that uses cross-chain signatures to automatically route public donation funds to river-cleanup NGOs based on verified IoT water sensor data.
ideas.title: ChainGanga
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly replicates the chain-signatures and automated execution patterns of Bitcoin-Agent, providing a high-impact social utility project that hackathon judges heavily favor.

ideas.pitch: An MMORPG-style web app for Delhi Metro commuters where AI non-player characters issue real-world exploration and transit quests rewarded with tokenized badges.
ideas.title: MetroQuest Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines gamification and AI agents following the winning formula of rpg-verse-agentic, ensuring high engagement during live judging demos at an in-person venue.
